description: Economy tier — cost-optimized for high-traffic coding on OpenCode Zen: gemini-3.5-flash-lite keeps flash orchestration affordable, gpt-6-luna powers predictable general work at $0.1/$0.5 (roughly ten times cheaper on input than the retired gpt-5.1 slot at $1.07/$8.5 on Zen), gpt-6-sol provides current-generation coding firepower at $2/$10 while honoring the red line, and deepseek-v4-pro handles max-tier reviews; vision routes to claude-sonnet-5 ($2/$10, superseding sonnet-4-6) for attachment-friendly requests. Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
